ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens: crinkled bright green leaves with ruffled edges and pale green midribs, plus some darker reddish-purple leaf fragments, lightly wilted and glossy with a thin dressing sheen, spread across roughly 55% of the plate in a loose mound about 15 cm across and 2-3 cm tall | 95
ITEM 2 | Single whole cherry tomato, glossy red with a slight shine, about 2.5 cm diameter, sitting on top of the greens near the right-center of the mound | 12
ITEM 3 | Small pale yellow-orange pieces, soft and slightly moist, about 0.5-1 cm each, scattered among the leaves (possibly bits of a crumbly topping), roughly 3 pieces visible | 4
ITEM 4 | Thin brownish dressing or oil residue, translucent and slightly glossy, smeared in small droplets and streaks on the white plate surface around the left and upper edges of the greens | 5
